Segnala offerta di lavoro We are the people who give possibilities purpose BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities. Job Description The position is responsible for leading the European Breast Surgery marketing strategy and business performance, driving growth across both the Aesthetic and Reconstruction portfolios, with a particular focus on the GalaFLEX franchise. The role owns the development and execution of marketing plans, commercialization strategies, product launches, market development initiatives, and omnichannel engagement programs to achieve revenue, profitability, and market share objectives. Responsibilities Develop and lead all aspects of marketing plans in Europe to ensure the achievement of financial/budget expectations and go-to-market strategies, including market sensing, market development and marketing mix. Lead the successful development and flawless implementation of new product launches and related commercialization plans, strategies and activities. Direction provided has a direct impact on the achievement of the region's revenue results. Develop deep insights through research and analytics to inform marketing and product development decision-making, plans, activities and the organization. Lead the Breast Surgery business strategy and marketing execution across Europe. Ensure alignment across countries, business leaders, and commercial teams while fostering market development opportunities with the Breast market (aesthetic and reconstruction). Drive successful commercialization and launch of new products. Generate customer, market, and competitive insights to inform strategic decisions. Develop and execute European Breast brand, communication, and promotional strategies. Partner with Sales, Upstream Marketing, Business Development, Professional Education, and Omnichannel teams to accelerate growth. Develop a digital marketing plan together with the Omnichannel team to optimize BD digital presence in the Breast Surgery space. Optimize portfolio lifecycle management, including product development activities. Direct, in collaboration with the Professional Education team, European professional education initiatives, including congresses, workshops, and training programs. Represent Europe on the Global Breast Platform Team and contribute to innovation initiatives. Lead CRM data governance and support data-driven decision-making. Own revenue, budget, and gross profit performance for the portfolio. Qualifications / Experience Minimum of 5-7 years of business/marketing experience in the med tech industry, ideally within Aesthetic or Breast surgery market Minimum of 3 years in product and/or marketing management. Bachelor’s degree, MBA, medical or scientific graduate degree preferred Experience in delivering product launches & conversion strategies is preferred Demonstrated success in translating business needs into product and product portfolio strategies Strong & effective communication and analytical skills, with strong technical marketing acumen Experience of working in a large matrix organization Demonstrated ability to work well with teams Ability to influence without authority, using relationships and networks within the BD matrix to influence strategies within the region and at a global level Customer centric & highly analytical and able to clearly identify customer needs and requirements Fluent in English. Additional languages are considered as an advantage CRM Skills (Sales Force) The salary range for this role is: 90k to 100k CCNL Chimico Farmaceutico Why Join Us? To find purpose in the possibilities, we need people who can see the bigger picture, who understand the human story that underpins everything we do. We welcome people with the imagination and drive to help us reinvent the future of healthcare. At BD, you’ll discover a culture in which you can learn, grow and thrive. We believe that when people connect in person, we learn faster, collaborate more deeply, and build a stronger culture. Join us and enjoy a culture where face-to-face collaboration supports your learning, your progress, and your success. To learn more about BD visit https://bd.com/careers. Il gap più rilevante è l’assenza di un’esperienza specifica nel settore “monetizzazione” di prodotti B2B‑B2C, ma la sua comprovata esperienza in lead generation, go‑to‑market e gestione di team cross‑funzionali lo rende comunque adatto.

Segnala offerta di lavoro LHH ha fornito un livello di retribuzione Questo livello è fornito da LHH. La tua retribuzione effettiva sarà basata sulle tue competenze e la tua esperienza. Rivolgiti al tuo recruiter per saperne di più. Livello retribuzione di base 80.000,00 €/yr - 100.000,00 €/anno Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da LHH Lidio Antonello Lombardi Lidio Antonello Lombardi Senior Director Associate presso LHH Recruitment Solutions | Startup & Scaleup Lover |  Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt | My 2cents Fighter Importante gruppo editoriale e media company italiana, proprietario di alcuni dei più riconosciuti brand d'informazione nazionali e locali, è alla ricerca di un Marketing Manager & Monetizzazione da inserire all'interno di un ambizioso percorso di evoluzione digitale e sviluppo dei modelli di monetizzazione. La figura avrà un ruolo centrale nel guidare le attività di marketing performance, customer acquisition e subscription growth, contribuendo alla crescita del business digitale, degli abbonamenti e delle iniziative eventi. Riportando al top management, il Marketing Manager & Monetizzazione avrà la responsabilità di definire e implementare le strategie di acquisizione e monetizzazione, coordinando un team dedicato e gestendo i relativi investimenti di marketing. Sarà responsabile del raggiungimento degli obiettivi quantitativi legati a traffico, acquisizione abbonati, retention, crescita delle newsletter e generazione di lead per il business eventi, assicurando il costante monitoraggio delle performance e l'ottimizzazione degli investimenti sui diversi canali. Lavorerà in stretta collaborazione con i team di Marketing Strategico, Product Management ed Editoriale per garantire l'efficace lancio e promozione dei prodotti digitali. Responsibilities Definire e implementare le strategie di digital marketing e customer acquisition. Gestire e ottimizzare budget media orientati alla crescita di traffico, abbonamenti e lead generation. Guidare le attività di performance marketing presidiando tutti i principali canali di acquisizione. Monitorare KPI di business e marketing, identificando opportunità di miglioramento delle performance. Sviluppare strategie di conversione e retention, ottimizzando funnel, paywall, pricing e promozioni. Coordinare le attività di marketing automation e CRM. Collaborare con Product Manager e Marketing Strategico nella pianificazione e nell'esecuzione delle campagne. Guidare e sviluppare il team marketing, favorendo una cultura data-driven e orientata ai risultati. Supportare la crescita delle attività di subscription e, in prospettiva, lo sviluppo di partnership B2B per gli abbonamenti corporate. Your Profile Laurea in Marketing, Economia, Comunicazione o discipline affini. Esperienza consolidata in ruoli di Digital Marketing, Performance Marketing o Growth Marketing. Provenienza preferenziale da agenzie media digitali, telco, pay-tv, e-commerce, subscription business o realtà digitali particolarmente evolute. Solida esperienza nella gestione di investimenti media e budget marketing complessi. Competenze approfondite in performance marketing, marketing automation, attribution modelling e analytics. Conoscenza delle logiche di customer acquisition, subscription, retention e churn management. Esperienza nella gestione di team e nel coordinamento di stakeholder multidisciplinari. Forte orientamento ai dati, capacità analitiche e approccio imprenditoriale. Bonus annuale collegato al raggiungimento degli obiettivi. Smart working: 2 giorni a settimana Ticket restaurant. Assicurazione sanitaria integrativa. Welfare aziendale. Dotazione aziendale (PC e smartphone). Accesso agevolato ai prodotti e servizi del Gruppo. Formazione continua e percorsi di sviluppo manageriale. Holidu is one of the world’s fastest-growing vacation rental technology companies. Our mission is to make booking and hosting holiday homes free of doubt and full of joy, by helping hosts generate more bookings with less work and helping guests find a holiday home they truly enjoy. Our team of 700 colleagues from 60+ nations shares a passion for tech, an ambition for constant improvement, and a relentless drive to bring the best experience to more than 40k vacation rental hosts and 4 million annual guests. About Us Holidu is one of the world’s fastest-growing holiday rental technology companies. Our mission is to make booking and hosting holiday homes free of doubt and full of joy, by helping hosts generate more bookings with less work and helping guests find a holiday home they truly enjoy. Our team of 700 colleagues from 60+ nations shares a passion for tech, an ambition for constant improvement, and a relentless drive to bring the best experience to more than 40k holiday rental hosts and 4 million annual guests. Your future team Holidu offers a software and service solution which helps hosts manage and distribute their properties more efficiently. As we expand our presence in Italy, you will play a crucial role in supporting the establishment and success of our team in Milan This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the growth and culture of a dynamic and ambitious team. As a key member of the Italy Northwest team, you will collaborate with colleagues to drive our mission forward while fostering a motivated and innovative work environment. What you will do Reach out to vacation rental owners and execute sales strategies (mostly by cold calling) to find out if Holidu is the right solution for their needs. Generate sales by handling all aspects of the sales cycle from prospecting to closing. Be rigorous in activity tracking and monitor your completion of monthly targets. Conduct regular business trips to your focus regions and gain valuable market insights. Support the onboarding process of new team members and share your knowledge with other international sales teams at Holidu. Help in organising events to promote Holidu and build a community of hosts. Our salary package reflects your background and expertise. For a Senior Sales Manager based remotely in Milan , the typical starting range we offer is an OTE (on-target earnings) of 50.000€ - 57.920€ gross per year, the final offer depends on your skills and qualifications. Of this, 70% is typically fixed and 30% variable. Your variable pay rewards results and comes with real upside: strong over-achievement is boosted by a multiplier of up to 1.3x , and there is significant headroom to earn well beyond target, up to 350% of your variable target. What you bring 5+ years of professional experience in sales, or business development. High level of self-motivation and ability to convince our hosts both on the phone (cold calling) and face to face. Positive mindset towards new challenges and empathic personality that enables strong interpersonal relationships. Solution-driven attitude and the ability to work in a responsible and organised way. Preferred but not mandatory: experience in sales or account management, travel industry or online business. Near native Italian skills and fluent English skills. Drivers licence. What we offer Impact: Shape the future of travel with products used by millions of guests and thousands of hosts. At Holidu ideas become products, data drives decisions, and iteration fuels fast learning. Your work matters—and you’ll see the impact. Learning: Grow professionally in a culture that thrives on curiosity and feedback. You’ll learn from outstanding colleagues, collaborate across disciplines, and benefit from mentorship, and personal learning budgets—with a strong focus on AI. Great People: Join a team of smart, motivated and international colleagues who challenge and support each other. We celebrate wins and keep our culture fun, ambitious and human. Our customers are guests and hosts—people we can all relate to—making work meaningful and energizing. Technology: Work in a modern tech environment. You’ll experience the pace of a scale-up combined with the stability of a proven business model, enabling you to build, test, and improve continuously. Flexibility: Work a hybrid setup with 50% in-office time for collaboration, and spend up to 8 weeks a year from other inspiring locations. You’ll stay connected through regular events and meet-ups across our almost 30 offices. Perks on Top: Of course, we also offer travel benefits, gym discounts, and other perks to keep you energized—but what truly sets us apart is the chance to grow in a dynamic industry, alongside amazing people, while having fun along the way. Need a sneak peek? Check out the adventure that awaits you on Instagram @lifeatholiduand dive straight into the world of Sales at Holidufor more insight! Apply now! Apply online on our career page! Your first travel contact will be Gloria from HR. We are committed to diversity in all aspects of our business. We encourage applications from all genders, all corners of the world and all individual backgrounds. You are welcome to submit your application without a photo and without stating your gender, date of birth, marital status, nationality or disability status (if applicable). If you require any special assistance when arranging interviews, office visits or the recruitment process in general, please contact the relevant HR person responsible for this job and we will do our best to accommodate your needs.
